name: slack
description: A Beaver tool that can search, read and write Slack messages, threads and reactions. This tool is not linked to or affiliated with Slack or Salesforce in any way.
author: Patrick Hunziker <patrick@hunziker.io>

slack_search.description: Searches Slack messages using Slack search syntax (e.g. 'deploy in:#ops from:@alice after:2026-01-01'). Returns the most recent matches first unless sort or sort_dir say otherwise. Requires a user token (xoxp-) with the search:read scope.

count.description: The maximum number of matches to return (1-100, default 20).

sort.description: Order by message time (timestamp, default) or by relevance (score).

sort_dir.description: Sort direction: desc (default, newest or most relevant first) or asc.

slack_read.description: Reads recent messages from a Slack channel, or all messages of a thread if thread_ts is given. Requires the channels:history (and groups:history for private channels) scope.

thread_ts.description: An optional timestamp of the thread's parent message. If given, the thread's messages are returned instead of the channel history.

limit.description: The maximum number of messages to return (1-200).

oldest.description: Only messages after this timestamp. Ignored when thread_ts is given.

latest.description: Only messages before this timestamp. Ignored when thread_ts is given.

slack_post.description: Posts a new message to a Slack channel. Returns the channel and the message timestamp (ts), which can be used as thread_ts to start a thread. Requires the chat:write scope.

text.description: The message text in Slack mrkdwn format.

slack_reply.description: Replies in the thread of a Slack message. Starts a new thread if the message has none yet. Requires the chat:write scope.

thread_ts.description: The timestamp of the thread's parent message.

text.description: The reply text in Slack mrkdwn format.

broadcast.description: Also show the reply in the channel (default false).

slack_react.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a Slack message. Requires the reactions:write scope.

timestamp.description: The timestamp (ts) of the message to react to.

name.description: The emoji name, with or without colons (e.g. tada or :tada:).
